hook.name: NasdankFeeHookPairUniversal
hook.description: A fee hook that takes a fixed percentage of the pair-token leg on every swap, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager. At claim time, fees are split between a project treasury (paid in pair tokens) and a protocol treasury (converted to WETH via a frozen direct or two-hop V3 route with TWAP-floor slippage protection).
